mentions.name: All About Berlin
mentions.description: This independent website is the author's primary source of income and has lost 80-85% of its traffic versus the same month pre-LLMs, as AI systems train on its work and use it to deny it an audience. In response, the author is cutting operating costs to the bare minimum: shutting down one service, replacing a VPS with Cloudflare Workers, trimming SaaS subscriptions, and self-hosting what they can.
mentions.problem: AI systems train on the site's content and use it to divert its audience; traffic is down 80-85% from pre-LLM levels and the author fears the site will be dead within a year.
mentions.source_excerpt:
